title: alpha-AOS project pack receipt
description: Closed contract for the record that will describe a materialized project pack. This phase defines and validates the envelope only; materialization and removal are phase 3.

evidenceHash.description: Digest of the evidence envelope that selected this pack.

kind.description: What sort of project target this row claims. `skill` is the materialized SKILL.md under a project skill root. `sidecar` is the alpha-AOS provenance file written BESIDE it, on the surfaces where 03-RESEARCH.md proved the harness tolerates an unexpected file harmlessly (03-CONTEXT.md D-07); on every other surface no sidecar row is emitted and this receipt is the whole provenance record. A sidecar is a RECORDED row rather than a path derived at removal time, so it sits inside the drift guard planPackRemoval computes over each target's current hash — a hand-edited sidecar moves the removal digest and the approval refuses instead of deleting the edit. Project-scope MCP servers and policies are reported UNSUPPORTED rather than silently absent (03-CONTEXT.md D-05), so a reader never has to infer their absence from a missing row. An unregistered kind is inert under the phase 1 D-08/D-09 closed-world rule, so adding one later is an ADDITIVE change to this enum rather than a breaking change to the envelope.

harness.description: Exactly the harnesses that have a project-local skill root, i.e. the keys of PROJECT_SKILL_ROOTS in src/core/project-plan.ts. A receipt naming any other harness describes a target no removal could ever be confined to, so it is refused at the door rather than at the removal (02-REVIEW WR-03). Phase 3 WRITES receipts and must honour this narrowing: adding a harness here without adding it to PROJECT_SKILL_ROOTS reopens the crash.
